dc_to_ac_efficiency.description: SMA Efficiency and Derating, WirkungDerat-TI-en-53, version 5.3 (01/2023). Rated input voltage curve. The same DC conversion curve is used for AC-to-DC as an approximation; the SMA document gives no measured reverse-conversion curve.
